About

Fair examination means tracing evidence, identifying assumptions, and leaving uncertainty visible.

Attribution

Original SAB excerpts are attributed to Steve Wells and linked, without rewriting them. New explanatory summaries, interpretations, and evidence assessments are separately labeled as provisional editorial notes.

This is an independent concept, not an official SAB product. Original annotations are copyrighted by their author; the full archive has not been copied.

Evidence

A reconciliation can be possible without being historically demonstrated. Textual observations, theological premises, and independent corroboration have different roles. We do not use numerical credibility scores or give all arguments equal evidentiary weight.

Categories

These are provisional editorial classifications, separate from SAB’s own classifications. Counts describe this collection’s contents, not how many contradictions are true.

Features

No public comments, voting, leaderboards, embedded ads, or required research accounts. No automatically published AI annotations, AI contradiction ratings, or chatbot presented as an authority.

The evidence finder retrieves existing records. It does not generate answers. An AI research integration would require source citations, uncertainty, and human editorial review before publication.

Sources

Passage extracts use KJV and American Standard Version (1901). They are supplied for comparison; select “Read full context” to inspect the complete chapter. Two Genesis 2:19 extracts are visibly identified as excerpts in the translation note.

SAB and the two GotQuestions response pages were checked October 11, 2026. GotQuestions is a confessional Christian source, not a substitute for peer-reviewed historical scholarship.

Privacy

Bookmarks and notes use browser storage, with JSON and Markdown exports. They do not sync across devices. A shared passage link shares the study, not your notes.

The initial hosting is owner-private for review. Public account-free access can be enabled when this concept is ready for release.
